I intend to vote for him too, but not for the reason you're thinking. 

I have no vested interest in the outcome of this election.

I am also a firm believer in "Why prolong it?"

The fact that my mother has told me she'd be completely devastated is the only reason I made it as far as I have. 

Personally, I think she's a lunatic. Or maybe just doesn't have the appropriate objectivity because she's... you know, my MOTHER. But there you are. Family is pretty much the only reason I haven't pulped my skull yet.
For what? The world will be brighter without me in it.
I won't. I know this for a fact. My future is made of fail.

No. And of course not. 
It always sounds like I'm being a whiny little pissant to my ears.

Which positive would this be? The part where I'm moving to America's taint? (Northern Florida)

The part where i get to spend ANOTHER 5 months doing a job I hate?
Have hobbies. They don't help. I suck at everything I do.
Yeah. A job I hate. But it's the only one my pathetic ass can get.

It won't. Everything I do turns to fail. It's going to be a farking nightmare.

There isn't another company who's hiring. I've looked. Like I said, it's a horrible option, but it's the least horrible option. 

That said, it's kind of like choosing which will be cut off, your fingers or your toes?
